p4.original: 人格是什么？从古到今，人格理论家们给出了各种答案。气质理论和特质理论将人格描述成静态的图景；你会发现若干人格维度将人格的描述变得简单，平时你也会有意无意地按照各种特质维度来进行人格判断。人格过程理论会告诉你，人格是我们的内部心理过程和社会交互的结果；心理动力学理论强调的内部心理过程是无意识动机和过去的经验（特别是童年早期经验），人本主义理论强调意识和我们对当前现实的主观看法，存在主义理论寻找个体存在的意义及生活的目标，社会认知理论关注学习、感知和社会互动对我们当前行为的综合影响。然而，人们日常生活中对自己和他人的了解是以朴素的人格假设（内隐人格理论）和自我叙述为基础的。这容易受到社会文化的影响，并且可能会出错。
p4.en: What's your personality? From time to time, personality theorists have given various answers. (a) The gas and quality theory depicts the personality as static; You'll find that a number of personality dimensions make the description of personality simple, and you'll be able to make a personal judgement, intentionally and inadvertently, based on the characteristics of personality. The theory of the process of personality tells you that personality is the result of our internal psychological processes and social interactions; The psychological process, which is emphasized by psychodynamic theory, is an unconscious motivation and past experience (especially early childhood experience), the humanist theory emphasizes awareness and our subjective view of current realities, the existential theory seeks the meaning of the individual's existence and the goals of life, and the social cognitive theory focuses on the combined effects of learning, perception and social interaction on our current behaviour. However, people's knowledge of themselves and others in their daily lives is based on simple personality assumptions (invisible personality theory) and self-presentation. This is vulnerable to sociocultural influences and can lead to mistakes.

p5.original: 在这些论述中你会发现，人格代表了独特性，是贯穿个体一生的思想、情感和行为背后的一致性和稳定性倾向。就像指纹、雪花的独特性一样，内在倾向、特质以及性格特征结合起来也构成了每个人独一无二的特性。你也会了解到，人格-情境争论动摇了人格稳定性的基础，但人格的独特性仍然成立，只不过需要考虑情境的作用。情境不只是人格发展的背景，它具有更多的心理学特征和意义，这些特征可能反映了人格的一部分。
p5.en: In these statements, you will find that personality represents uniqueness and a tendency towards consistency and stability behind ideas, emotions and behaviours throughout an individual's life cycle. Like fingerprints, snowflakes and the uniqueness of snowflakes, the combination of intrinsic tendencies, traits and character characteristics constitutes a unique characteristic of each individual. You will also learn that the personality-situation debate has shaken the foundations of personal stability, but that the uniqueness of the personality is still valid, although the role of the situation needs to be considered. The situation is not just a context of personality development; it has more psychological features and meaning, which may reflect part of the personality.

p6.original: 在本章中，你可以从四个层次来解读独一无二的人格：（1）每个人都与众不同；（2）人格的研究方法也与众不同：人格方向寻求独特性，其他心理学方向大多寻求人类的共性；（3）独特的个体在不同人格理论下的解读结果也是独特的；（4）人与情境的交互作用也是独特性的一种体现。与其他书不同，本书作者将同一个人（著名心理学家卡尔金斯）的人格贯穿于全章，为你呈现了不同人格理论如何解读同一个人，并从人格、情境和生物学的交互作用方面启发你去思考人格的稳定性和发展性等前沿问题，阐释人格研究的思维方式，为你更好地理解和测量人格奠定基础，最终了解是什么力量塑造了我们的人格。阅读本章，会让独特的你收获一份对人格的独特理解。
p6.en: In this chapter, you can read the unique personality at four levels: (1) each person is different; (2) The approach to the study of personality is also different: it seeks to be unique, and most of the other psychological directions seek to be human in common; (3) Unique individuals are also unique in their interpretation under different personality theories; (4) The interaction of people with circumstances is also an expression of uniqueness. Unlike other books, the authors of this book, which transposes the personality of the same person (known psychologist Carlkins) throughout the chapter, present for you how the theory of different personalities interprets the same person and inspires you to reflect on the front-line issues of personality stability and development in terms of the interaction of personality, context and biology, explaining the way in which personality studies are thought, laying the foundation for a better understanding and measurement of personality, and ultimately understanding what forces shape our personality. Reading this chapter will give you a unique understanding of the human personality.

p8.en: Professor, Department of Psychology, People's University of China

p9.original: 在成长为独特的自我的过程中将自己当作独一无二的人。
p9.en: I see myself as a unique person in the process of developing into a unique self.
